title: Publish DiffEqGPU CRN benchmark
body:
Ignore this PR until it has been reviewed by @ChrisRackauckas.

## What changed and why

Publish the completed `DiffEqGPU/crn_sde` page and its figure from the retained artifact of the cancelled benchmark matrix. The CRN job completed successfully before the unrelated Lorenz job stalled; publishing this focused artifact prevents that valid result from remaining stranded while the fresh V100 rerun proceeds.

## Verification

- Source job completed successfully on `Tesla V100-PCIE-32GB`: https://github.com/SciML/SciMLBenchmarks.jl/actions/runs/33935171559/job/101221623965
- Downloaded artifact `benchmark-benchmarks-DiffEqGPU-crn_sde-jmd` (artifact ID `9960295751`) and copied only its Markdown and referenced PNG.
- SHA-256 matched the downloaded artifact before removing its two superfluous trailing blank lines; `git diff --check` then passed.
- The rendered page contains four finite smoke-test state values and reports 115.345 ms GPU versus 335.900 ms CPU for 6,720 trajectories, and 357.440 ms versus 1,505.764 ms for 26,880 trajectories.
- The 576×384 PNG is nonempty, referenced by the Markdown, and was visually inspected as a populated two-series log-scale plot.
- `julia +1.12.7 --project=docs docs/make.jl` completed with exit status 0. Documenter emitted only warnings already present in the full output corpus.
- `git diff --check` passed. `typos` found only `Comput.`, the correct journal abbreviation in the paper citation.

## Not verified

SciMLBenchmarksOutput has no configured test or QA suite beyond its documentation build. Lorenz and linear-SDE output are intentionally absent from this PR because those jobs did not complete in the cancelled run.
